name: Display
summary: Workspace to publish, share and organize the docs, prototypes and apps your AI agents create.
description: Display hosts HTML and Markdown files produced by Claude, Codex, Cursor or scripts via a CLI, organizes them in spaces and folders, and shares them publicly or behind company sign-in, turning agent output into an internal knowledge base. Pricing is per storage and features, not seats: Free plan, Solo $9/month (yearly) or $12 monthly, Team $59, Business $199.
